title: Volunteer Hours vs Household Capacity Balance
dataSources: Volunteer shifts (`community:shift`), donations (`community:donation`), mutual-aid requests (`community:mutualaid`), service ops (`community:impact`).
app: Community-service telemetry — food-bank shift logs, blood-donation records, and mutual-aid request maps — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=community:impact capacity_band=*
| stats count as items by capacity_band
| eventstats sum(items) as total
| eval share_pct=round(100*items/total,1)
| sort - share_pct
description: Shows how service weeks split across capacity band for household volunteering balance.
value: Share-of-total views make it easier to see imbalance, over-concentration, and neglected areas inside household volunteering balance.
implementation: Capture each service weeks event in `community:impact` and normalize `capacity_band` so Splunk can compute the share by capacity band.
visualization: Table of capacity band with item count and share percentage.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how service weeks are divided across capacity band so you can tell if one part of household volunteering balance is taking over.
